name: @etzhayyim/hrse-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of hrse (public cybersecurity freelance JOB-BOARD catalog: hiring company + job posting) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW/Postgres). (c) mixed split: the public browse surface migrates; the marketplace backend (freelancer/applicant PII, matching, Clerk subscription/billing, placement liability) stays etzhayyim via consent-capability. Postings carry no applicant PII. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
